comparator.name: Cultural Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 timetable lists twelve distinct 5 EC foundation courses. The study guide and current graduation course page confirm a 15 EC final research component. The guide’s table gives inconsistent credit allocations for the degree, and the available programme-specific regulations and implementation rules are dated 2025–2026. The displayed components are the confirmed subset.
components: Introduction to Cultural Studies: Cultural Perspectives on the Climate Debate
The Power of Stories: Introduction to Narrative Analysis
Images of the Past: Introduction to Historical Thinking
The Art of Seeing: Introduction to Visual Analysis
Revolution! Political and Cultural Upheavals in Historical Perspective
Cultural Memory: Changing Images of the Second World War
The Bachelor Graduation Project is a 15 EC alternative to the thesis practicum.
